validations.message: The brief's cohort_id must be its plan cohort's id.
The brief's repository_key must be its plan cohort's.
The brief's depends_on must be its plan cohort's, in the same order.
The brief's acceptance_criteria ids must be its plan cohort's, in the same order.

done_when.source: approved(assessment) and published(build_result) and pr_published and (merged_pr or approved(pr))

when.source: pr_published and approved(assessment) and not merged_pr and not approved(pr)

value.source: {owner: input.repository.forge.owner, name: input.repository.forge.name, head_owner: input.workspace.push_remote_owner, head_branch: latest(pr).branch, base_branch: watch_base, pr_url: latest(pr).pr_url}

done_when.source: published(assessment) and approved(pr) and (approved(manual_merge_target) or (observed_state_current and (latest(observed_state).state == "merged" or (input.final_merge_policy == "allow_close_without_merge" and latest(observed_state).state == "closed_unmerged"))))

when.source: published(manual_merge_target) and not final_state and not closed_pr and not approved(manual_merge_target)

value.source: {owner: input.repository.forge.owner, name: input.repository.forge.name, head_owner: input.workspace.push_remote_owner, head_branch: latest(pr).branch, base_branch: watch_base, pr_url: latest(pr).pr_url}

validations.message: The plan must name at least one cohort.
Every cohort's repository_key must be the key of one of the run's repositories.
Cohort ids must be unique idents, and each depends_on must name other cohorts without repeats or a cycle.
Every cohort acceptance id must be the id of a task in the approved task list.

expression.source: every(map(input.tasks.tasks, item.id), contains(flatten(map(plan.cohorts, map(item.acceptance_criteria, item.id))), item))

validations.message: Every task in the approved task list must appear in at least one cohort's acceptance_criteria.
A task id may appear only once within a cohort's acceptance_criteria; repeating it in another cohort is valid.
